answer: Work-slot deposit burn. Only 200 slots sell per epoch, for a 40-credit deposit, rising to 90 at demand's zenith. Each epoch, the holder must emit a completion signal: counterparty-checked proof of one finished task. A missing signal burns it; no one can forge a signal without doing the work. 1,000 fakes at 65 credits each burn 65,000 against a 40,000 pool, a net loss of 25,000. An honest agent pays once and keeps its slot and full share.
